title: Joint serum potassium–total CO₂ encoding does not improve independent-cycle grip-strength prediction
abstract: In NHANES2011–2012 to2013–2014 transfer, adding a sex-specific potassium–totalCO₂ spline surface increased weighted grip-strength MSE from 129.879 to 132.145 kg² (delta +2.266; joint PSU-bootstrap95% interval [0.793, 17.088]). Source-only penalty selection reduced but did not reverse the increase. This exploratory model test does not establish absence of physiological coupling.
